test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Ebullient
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dejected**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antonym **means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word.
 
• The word **Ebullient **means cheerful and full of energy

*Example* : She is an honest and **ebullient **girl.

 
• The word **Dejected **means sad and depressed.

*Example* : I am feeling very **dejected** today.

 
• The meaning of word **Ebullient **is opposite of the meaning of word dejected . Hence Option 2 Dejected is the answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **carefree **means free from anxiety and stress.

*Example *: I wish I could be as **carefree **as him.

 
• The word **Buoyant **means ability of floating on top.

*Example* : Warm air is more **buoyant **than cool air

 
• The word **Roguish **means a trait of a dishonest or unprincipled person

*Example *: He played a rather **roguish **character in the film.
